title: Ringo Starr cancels All-Starr Band show in Holmdel, New Jersey | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band’s 27 September 2026 show at the PNC Bank Arts Center in Holmdel, New Jersey, USA, was cancelled due to stormy weather.

The show would have been the second date of the All-Starr Band’s fall tour of the USA, which will now last for nine dates in September and October 2026.

What’s happening it’s a lot of bad weather around and the government thought it’d be better if we didn’t cause any trouble and the fans wouldn’t get wet. I send you peace and love. See you next time and those in the NY area – see you at Forest Hills! 😎✌️🌟❤️
Ringo Starr

Starr had previously performed at the Holmdel Arts Center on 5 and 11 August 1989, 21 June 1992, 18 July 1995, 3 June 1997, 9 August 2001, 3 August 2003, 18 July 2006, and 27 June 2008.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
